messages.author: aa8d8a5c39930fde
messages.subject: highlighting bash code
parts: Is there a way to highlight code in chunks containing bash code (engine="bash"), just like R code is highlighted?

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] highlighting bash code
parts:
You mean in latex/pdf mode?

If you're using the markdown output format, you'll get valid markdown that most converters can highlight (e.g. you could pipe that through pandoc to get a latex file.  I guess in this case the R highlighting isn't as intelligent as the when it is handled in knitr, but pretty good.  

-Carl

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] highlighting bash code
parts:
At the moment it only considered in markdown and reST output, e.g.
https://github.com/yihui/knitr-examples/blob/master/027-engine-bash.md
(the code is put under ```bash)

The only difficulty for LaTeX output is to find a good LaTeX package.
I guess both listings and mint should be able to handle many different
languages. You can always reset the bash engine to customize the
output: https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/R/engine.R

Regards,
Yihui
